description: This is a Java JUnit test class for the CredentialsService component in the Eclipse Hono project. It contains tests for verifying failure scenarios when retrieving credentials, specifically when essential fields like 'type' or 'authId' are missing.

classes.name: BaseCredentialsServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the CredentialsService, testing failure cases for missing required fields.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the CredentialsService instance before all tests.

methods.name: testGetFailsForMissingType
methods.description: Tests that a request missing the 'type' field fails with a 400 error.

methods.name: testGetFailsForMissingAuthId
methods.description: Tests that a request missing the 'authId' field fails with a 400 error.

methods.name: createRequestForPayload
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage with specified action and payload for testing.

methods.name: createCredentialsService
methods.description: Creates a mock CredentialsService for testing purposes.
